title: Koko Eating Bananas
description:
Koko loves to eat bananas. There are `n` piles of bananas, the `ith` pile has `piles[i]` bananas. The guards have gone and will come back in `h` hours.

Koko can decide her bananas-per-hour eating speed of `k`. Each hour, she chooses a pile and eats `k` bananas from it. If the pile has less than `k` bananas, she eats all of them and won't eat any more during that hour.

Return the minimum integer `k` such that she can eat all the bananas within `h` hours.
hints: Binary search on the answer: the eating speed k.
For each candidate k, calculate total hours needed. If hours <= h, try smaller k.

solutions.explanation: Binary search on the eating speed. For each candidate speed, calculate total hours. If feasible (<= h), try smaller. Otherwise, try larger.

dryRunSteps.explanation: Input: piles=[3,6,7,11], h=8. Binary search speed in [1..11].
hours(6)=6 ≤ 8. Can we go slower? right = mid = 6. Search [1..6].
hours(3)=10 > 8. Too slow. left = mid+1 = 4. Search [4..6].
Try k=4. Hours: 1+2+2+3 = 8 ≤ 8. Feasible! right=4. left=right=4. Return 4. 🎯

realWorldUseCases.description: Finding the minimum server throughput (processing speed) needed to complete all tasks within a deadline — binary search on the answer.
